## Description

Updates the probability that the generating process changed as new observations arrive, and pauses or adapts a strategy when a changepoint is likely.

## Where it may fit

Abrupt structural breaks, spread breakdowns, volatility changes or regime shifts that invalidate historical calibration.

## Vehicles

Pairs/stat-arb, systematic macro, managed futures and adaptive position-sizing systems.

## Required data

Sequential returns/spreads/features, likelihood model, hazard prior, parameter history and timestamps.

## Caveats

False alarms and late detection are both costly; thresholds should be tested on synthetic breaks and multiple out-of-sample regimes.
